title: Swarmbly AI 3.0.0: integrated distribution of SwarmblyCore, SwarmblyLCE and SwarmblyApp
description:
Swarmbly AI is a decentralized, local-first AI system that splits the problem rather than the model. A local orchestrator keeps personal and sensitive work on the user's computer and sends public, decomposable work once to volunteer nodes running complete small language models; the answer is assembled locally.

This record is the integrated distribution. From version 3.0.0 this repository is the umbrella of the project: SwarmblyCore (protocol, specification, reference implementation, measurement harness and benchmark, formerly the whole repository), SwarmblyLCE (the Local Cognitive Extension, a memory that lives only on the user's device; own record 10.5281/zenodo.23289041) and SwarmblyApp (desktop client, peer-to-peer node and network monitor; own records under 10.5281/zenodo.23322638), at versions tested together and recorded in components.lock, with an interactive installer for macOS, Linux and Windows (quick or custom install).

Status: alpha. What is measured and what is not is stated in each component; the coherence-tax abandonment criterion is not met on its held-out test and the confidence map remains withdrawn. Licensing: software and specification under AGPL-3.0-or-later; document text under CC BY 4.0. The whitepaper (version 2) is deposited separately as 10.5281/zenodo.23031305.
notes: Defensive publication. The author asserts no patent claims over the disclosed techniques and places them in the public domain for patenting purposes. Elements E1-E18 are prior art from version 1.4 (10.5281/zenodo.21957088, 2026-08-14) and E19-E24 from version 2 (10.5281/zenodo.23031305, 2026-09-29); this distribution adds the integrated packaging of SwarmblyCore, SwarmblyLCE and SwarmblyApp and does not withdraw any earlier element. Governance intent is documented in GOVERNANCE.md (Swiss Verein now, Stiftung later; DCO not CLA; no premine and no transferable token).
